item.title: Delivery Dash
item.description:
Overview

Delivery Dash is a fast-paced arcade delivery game where players race through procedurally generated city streets, dodging traffic, navigating shortcuts, and managing their delivery route efficiency. Think Crazy Taxi meets Paperboy with a modern mobile-friendly control scheme.

Gallery

My Role

As Gameplay Programmer & Level Designer, I:

  • Built the core driving physics with arcade handling (drift, boost, handbrake turns)

Key Features

  • Arcade Driving Physics — Drift, boost, jump, and powerslide through tight corners
  • Route Optimization — Plan the most efficient delivery path for bonus rewards
  • Delivery packages - Different packages to deliver to NPC’s

Progress

  • ✅ Core driving mechanics & physics
  • ✅ Package delivery and completion
  • ✅ Sounds effects
  • ✅ Particle effects for drift/boost/collision
  • ⏳ Polish, VFX, sound design

Next Steps

  1. Complete remaining level
